dogecoin.text: Watching @westworld season 3 and swore I saw @spacex Falcon boosters landing in the background.  The autonomous vehicles seemed prophetic as well. I wonder if the @elonmusk brain was involved. Now I have to watch all episodes again to see if I can spot #dogecoin in use!

@elonmusk @heydave7 @dogecoin_devs Regarding the blockchains. I read an article about possible embedded data such as elicit images and such contained within the BTC blockchain.  Is this possible? What about the Doge blockchain? As an IT pro, my concern is security. What's to stop malware payloads hidden within?
